ideas.title: Cross-user prefix-to-realized-purchase memory retrieval
ideas.source_owned_claim: Memory bank stores prefix representations with next-item target values and uses retrieved keys/values in dual cross-attention.
ideas.adaptation: Bounded non-neural bucket-token similarity; mature prior daily-query purchase-set values; no encoder or neural module transplant.

novelty_delta.delta: retrieves situations paired with later outcomes rather than unordered co-audience/history
other-user prefix-to-outcome records can retrieve new-to-query-user SKU; not same-user candidate-specific previous-purchase context
explicit realized continuation memory rather than max versus mean interest vectors

ideas.matched_control: Same memory records, outcome values and budget; keys only latest timestamp bucket rather than full prefix tokens.
ideas.strict_past: prefix events<s; s+24h<=fit_cutoff<=available_at<=query; query user excluded; all same-second events grouped without arbitrary order
ideas.code_caveat: precached_knowledge_val includes validation target values; same-user shorter-length filter does not prove global continuation maturity
ideas.counter: generic popularity/repetitive browsing, weak overlap, memory sparsity and noise
ideas.source_gate: literal <=24 events then separately authorized 100Q / 20k memories / 1m admitted source rows / 4096 postings per query; >=20 Q with at least two distinct legal continuation candidates
ideas.fit_cost: memory materialization/index are paid fitted state; zero neural fits for cheap adaptation

ideas.title: Exact two-seed session-set completion
ideas.source_owned_claim: Frequent within-session itemsets are mined with FP-Max and become weighted hyperedges; Eq2 is a linear incidence projection.
ideas.adaptation: Retain exact observed view triples and require both antecedent seeds, rather than using projected item embeddings.

novelty_delta.delta: joint membership distinguishes equal-pairwise-projection worlds; no generic ItemCF or graph walk
two-item conjunction at SKU grain rather than directed pairwise action/category association

ideas.matched_control: Same admitted triples, weights and provenance; projected pair source gives half rule weight per observed antecedent; leave-query-user-out support in both branches.
ideas.strict_past: all training-set events<fit_cutoff; last observed query-session prefix only; NULL session unsupported; within-second permutation invariant
ideas.counter: triple sparsity; alternatives/noise rather than complements; strict firing loses partial-match coverage
ideas.source_gate: eight-triple Pasch-trade fixture; future 100Q / 1m admitted rows / 10k sessions / 50k rules / 1024 postings per query / <=12 distinct items per admitted session; >=20 firing Q; >=5 other supporting users/rule
ideas.fit_cost: dictionary mining and leave-user-out provenance paid; no neural fit; output cap does not cap discovery

ideas.title: Horizon-integrated delayed category-intent recurrence
ideas.source_owned_claim: Same-intent cross-session timing combines exponential and Normal kernels; paper Eq8 sums events, released code137-166 selects the latest eligible event.
ideas.adaptation: Numeric category proxy; first observed purchase timestamp per user/session/category; integrate positive truncated mixture kernel over fixed next24h with historical events held fixed; retrieve via category mass times identical item prior.

novelty_delta.delta: delayed nonmonotone bump, not constant or monotone recency weighting
cross-SKU category intent and summed episode excitation rather than residual survival since last same-pair purchase

ideas.matched_control: Same category support, episode source, base/item priors, integration and history; exponential-only kernel.
ideas.strict_past: known query time only, no future purchase TIME; exclude last observed session; no completed-gap-only fit; include source observation boundary/censor integrals; latest global metadata bucket<t NULL/conflict unsupported
ideas.counter: one-month weak identification, category mixing, logging repeats and extra parameter overfit
ideas.source_gate: literal equal-recency/different-earlier-episode histories and integral positivity; future100Q support probe; >=100 category episodes from >=20 users; risk observation beyond proposed bump
ideas.fit_cost: at most16 category states plus global; two bounded kernel estimations charged inside future overall cap; score is not calibrated survival probability
